_planNotes.copyRule: VERBATIM ONLY. Every templateData value below is a line Cody actually wrote (ad Headline/Description, image headline/sub-headline, the alternative hooks, or sentences from the AD1/AD2/AD3 body copy) — or a cited fact (Wang 2026 numbers, credentials, offer name). The DSI-1 microscripts were removed at Cody's request and replaced with body/hook lines. Nothing is paraphrased or stitched. Where a written line is two sentences, it is split only at its own sentence boundary (no word changes).
_planNotes.selection: Templates were chosen by FIT to the copy: a line goes on the creative whose slot holds it without trimming. The old plan's phrase-kill (cluster-34, 28-char slot) and stitched lines (e.g. 'WORKS HARD. STILL THE SAME SPEED.') were dropped because no verbatim line fits a 28-char kill slot and those strings were rewrites.
_planNotes.kickerHeadlineSubhead: Each card = auto locale kicker (eyebrow, '{CITY} SPORTS PARENTS' from the data tier) + a headline-class line + a subhead-class line, mapped from your Headline/Description and image headline/sub-headline structure.
_planNotes.guaranteeFlag: IMPORTANT: your ad-copy guarantee reads '+1 mph. +3 inches. 90 days. Or we keep training them free.' The brand kit LOCKS the guarantee role to its canonical wording: '+1 mph speed. +3" vertical. 90 days. Or your training is on us.' Per brand law the locked canonical renders on creatives (F1/F2/F3/FA1). Flagging so you can confirm or reconcile the two wordings.
_planNotes.media: Media follows the proven multisport-foundations-media pattern: STATICS set top-level asset.media (./assets/msf-<id>.jpg, a distinct Hamilton County middle-school frame-grab) → the runner natively injects a full-frame bg + legibility scrim + text shadows (run-campaign.mjs:242). MOTION sets top-level asset.clip (brand/video-templates/assets/msf-<id>.mp4) → the runner auto-detects the bg key + frame-extracts. E1 keeps its coach clip. No hand-built sidecars. F1 (stat-reveal) and BR1 (logo-sting) are intentionally BARE — same as the reference campaign (guarantee reveal + logo bumper render on solid brand backgrounds). Sources: local Hamilton County IG Stories (Carmel/AA-carmel/Noblesville), MS-preferred for the 8-12 band, drill-matched, no reuse. All starting points — swap/reposition in the editor.
